PinpointCounterOffensive.description: <style="Faction_Tau">Re'vas</style> can use her active ability {[maxNrOfActivations]} times per Battle. Additionally, she takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from all attacks, but loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> each time she is attacked by a unit with either the <style="Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> or <style="Terminator_Armor">Terminator Armour</style> traits, or by a unit that has <style=Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> from an ability.
